contents.name: Theorem 3.41, monogenic prime factorisation from polynomial reduction
contents.support: The lemma identifies the primes and residue fields by polynomial reduction and CRT, then applies the published choice-free ideal-factorisation theorem to obtain local DVR exponents. Its proved local nilpotency-index and residue-layer clauses are compared with the localized CRT quotient to recover each repeated-factor exponent.
